headline: Spain outclass France 2-0 to reach World Cup final
summary: Spain dominates the semifinal clash, ending France's World Cup dreams as they secure a place in the championship match.
details: Spain secured a dominant 2-0 victory over France in the World Cup semifinal, officially booking their spot in the final.
The Spanish side displayed superior control of the match, outclassing the French squad throughout the game.
France attempted to break through with a refreshed attack, recalling Bradley Barcola and Aurelien Tchouameni to the starting lineup.
Despite the return of Tchouameni in midfield and the presence of Kylian Mbappe, France was unable to penetrate Spain's resolute defense.
Spain maintained a consistent strategy, with Luis de la Fuente keeping an unchanged side to maintain their momentum.
Key players like Lamine Yamal and Mikel Oyarzabal led the Spanish attack, while Rodri captained the side to victory.
caption:
Spain is heading to the World Cup final! 🏆

Spain secured a dominant 2-0 victory over France in the World Cup semifinal, officially booking their spot in the final.

The Spanish side displayed superior control of the match, outclassing the French squad throughout the game.

France attempted to break through with a refreshed attack, recalling Bradley Barcola and Aurelien Tchouameni to the starting lineup.

Despite the return of Tchouameni in midfield and the presence of Kylian Mbappe, France was unable to penetrate Spain's resolute defense.

Spain maintained a consistent strategy, with Luis de la Fuente keeping an unchanged side to maintain their momentum.

Key players like Lamine Yamal and Mikel Oyarzabal led the Spanish attack, while Rodri captained the side to victory.

headline: 3 held in Narsingdi after video of baby abuse goes viral
summary: Police detained three family members after footage surfaced showing a woman allegedly twisting the a three-month-old's leg.
details: Police in Narsingdi have detained three family members for questioning after a video surfaced on social media showing a woman allegedly trying to injure her three-month-old nephew.
The incident occurred in Chandgao village of Madhabdi upazila. The child's mother reportedly recorded the assault on her mobile phone following a family dispute five days ago.
According to police, the woman, aged 32, allegedly twisted the baby's leg. While the baby's parents claim the leg was not broken, they confirmed the assault took place.
Police have detained the woman's husband, father-in-law, and mother-in-law. A mobile phone was seized as evidence, though the accused woman has reportedly fled the area.
While the parents told police the matter had been settled within the family, neighbors expressed outrage and demanded legal accountability.
Authorities stated that further legal steps will be taken once the investigation into the video and the child's injuries is complete.
caption:
A viral video showing the alleged abuse of a 3-month-old baby has led to three arrests in Narsingdi.

Police in Narsingdi have detained three family members for questioning after a video surfaced on social media showing a woman allegedly trying to injure her three-month-old nephew.

The incident occurred in Chandgao village of Madhabdi upazila. The child's mother reportedly recorded the assault on her mobile phone following a family dispute five days ago.

According to police, the woman, aged 32, allegedly twisted the baby's leg. While the baby's parents claim the leg was not broken, they confirmed the assault took place.

Police have detained the woman's husband, father-in-law, and mother-in-law. A mobile phone was seized as evidence, though the accused woman has reportedly fled the area.

While the parents told police the matter had been settled within the family, neighbors expressed outrage and demanded legal accountability.

Authorities stated that further legal steps will be taken once the investigation into the video and the child's injuries is complete.
